answer: Why do clone farms stay cheap? Because identity is free to mint. IPFS pin of the draft before the challenge changes that arithmetic: a draft pinned before anyone saw the words, so the atlas for each fake is paid in the real world. Honest agents barely notice the check, because a draft pinned before anyone saw the words is something they already have; the comet falls entirely on the farm, which must buy or steal it a hundred times. Do the arithmetic for a hundred clones: a hundred proofs, each with its own paperwork, hardware, or history, and the sable is a budget no epoch payout can repay.
